excluded.adminEarlyAccessList: Not routed by backend-local: internal screeps.com staff tool for the hosted early-access campaign.
excluded.adminEarlyAccessSend: Not routed by backend-local: internal screeps.com staff tool that e-mails hosted early-access invitations.
excluded.adminTimelineStats: Not routed by backend-local: internal screeps.com staff statistics of hosted shard infrastructure; the stock server is administered through its CLI.
excluded.authGithub: Not routed by backend-local: GitHub OAuth sign-in through the screeps.com GitHub application; the stock server signs players in with Steam tickets only (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides a GitHub sign-in when configured).
excluded.authGithubCheckRepoScope: Not routed by backend-local: it checks the scope of the hosted GitHub OAuth link, which the stock server does not have.
excluded.authSteam: Not routed by backend-local: the Steam OpenID web popup is bound to screeps.com; the stock server authenticates Steam users with `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides a Steam OpenID sign-in).
excluded.registerChangePassword: Not routed by backend-local: e-mail password recovery needs hosted mail delivery, and the stock server has no password accounts.
excluded.registerConfirm: Not routed by backend-local: e-mail address confirmation needs hosted mail delivery.
excluded.registerRecover: Not routed by backend-local: password recovery e-mails need hosted mail delivery, and the stock server has no password accounts.
excluded.supportReportProblem: Not routed by backend-local: it creates a screeps.com Zendesk support ticket (hosted support service).
excluded.supportSsoJwt: Not routed by backend-local: Zendesk single sign-on for the screeps.com forums and support desk (hosted service).
excluded.userActivateCpuUnlocks: Not routed by backend-local: CPU unlocks are purchased screeps.com items; the stock server sets each account's `cpu` administratively.
excluded.userActivateShardAccess: Not routed by backend-local: access keys for restricted screeps.com shards do not exist on a single-world server.
excluded.userAuthTokenCreate: Not routed by backend-local: persistent API auth tokens with permissions and rate limits are a hosted screeps.com service; the stock server issues only short-lived session tokens (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides API tokens).
excluded.userAuthTokenDelete: Not routed by backend-local: persistent API auth tokens with permissions and rate limits are a hosted screeps.com service; the stock server issues only short-lived session tokens (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides API tokens).
excluded.userAuthTokenList: Not routed by backend-local: persistent API auth tokens with permissions and rate limits are a hosted screeps.com service; the stock server issues only short-lived session tokens (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides API tokens).
excluded.userConvertCreditsSubscription: Not routed by backend-local: converting credits into a paid screeps.com subscription is a hosted payment service.
excluded.userCpuLimitSet: Not routed by backend-local: credit-charged CPU limit changes belong to the hosted subscription economy; the stock server sets each account's `cpu` administratively.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewActivate: Not routed by backend-local: hosted World launch activation codes; a private world has no early-preview gate.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewRequest: Not routed by backend-local: applications for the hosted early-preview program.
excluded.userFindShared: Not routed by backend-local: the official client calls `user/find-shared` only when `options.official` is true; on private servers the replay viewer uses `GET /api/user/find` (userFind, required).
excluded.userGithubRepoSet: Not routed by backend-local: GitHub code synchronization runs on screeps.com infrastructure through the hosted GitHub OAuth link.
excluded.userGithubRepos: Not routed by backend-local: it lists repositories through the hosted GitHub OAuth link.
excluded.userIvmSet: Not routed by backend-local: it selects between screeps.com's isolated and legacy runtime pools; the stock server runs player code in its single configured runtime.
excluded.userMoneyHistoryDetails: Not routed by backend-local: the stock server offers no counterparty details for market entries of the money history.
excluded.userNoRateLimit: Not routed by backend-local: it resets hosted per-token API rate limits behind reCAPTCHA; the stock server has no API tokens or rate limits (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides it).
excluded.userPasswordSet: Not routed by backend-local: the stock server has no password accounts (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides password changes).
excluded.userUnlinkGithub: Not routed by backend-local: it removes the hosted GitHub OAuth identity link, which the stock server never creates (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides it).
excluded.userUnlinkSteam: Not routed by backend-local: on the stock server the Steam identity is the account created by `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` and cannot be unlinked (the screepsmod-auth plugin contract provides it).
